environment: phrase-final in polysyllabic words, after a nasal
notes: Final Short Vowel Devoicing: 'Phrase-final short high vowels of polysyllabic words devoice after a nasal and before pause', motivated in part by their lack of stress. A companion rule, Final Long Vowel Shortening, optionally shortens phrase-final long high vowels after a nasal (p. 38); PMc has no long vowels here (decision rehg1993-pmc).
via_note: Rehg (1993) restates the rule as reconstructed in Rehg (1991) and adds that Pulo-Annan data suggest devoicing rather than deletion of the second mora of long vowels (n. 30).
